name: Asagiri Kanna
source:
"...Is it ok, if I ask you something?"

A girl who was brought to Onigasato to become [url=/c44373]Kaki's[/url] bride.
She's quiet and doesn't show expressions much.
Because of the curse of being the "Oni's Bride' men will always be tempted by her and she will be hated by other women.
